cross_references.note: ADA Title I (15+ employees) runs parallel to FEHA §12940 (5+ employees). Always plead both. FEHA offers broader coverage (5-employee threshold; substantial motivating reason causation; 3-year SOL); ADA triggers Unruh per se ($4,000 minimum). ADA violation = per se CIV §51 violation under §51(f).
ADA Title I violation is per se CIV §51 violation under §51(f). Each ADA employment discrimination offense → $4,000 minimum statutory damages under CIV §52. No separate California analysis required.

CA_Labor_Employment_Litigator owns the FEHA employment discrimination and retaliation track. ADA Title I and FEHA §12940 are parallel tracks — coordinate to ensure both are pled in employment disability cases.

Industrial injury creates both WC entitlement (WCAB track) and ADA Title I accommodation obligation (civil court track). WCAB exclusive jurisdiction does not preempt ADA Title I. The disability caused by the industrial injury is the impairment triggering the ADA accommodation duty.
